t: This is the statue of Johnny Haynes in Fulham, by the sculptor Douglas Jennings. Haynes was an inside forward, nicknamed the Maestro for his two-footed passing, vision and delicate touch. He is widely regarded as Fulham's greatest ever player. He stayed loyal to the club for twenty years, and his best run in a cup was two FA Cup semi-finals. He won 56 England caps, 22 as captain. When the maximum wage was abolished in 1961, he became the first player paid a hundred pounds a week.
